stories.title: Real‑yield rise and ACM term‑premium uptick have elevated long yields
stories.whatChanged: 10Y nominal yield is elevated and 10Y real yield has risen alongside a +10.2 bp ACM term‑premium move.
stories.whyItMatters: Higher long and real yields raise discount rates and borrowing costs, tightening conditions even if credit is still calm.
stories.mechanism: Real‑yield strength plus an observed term‑premium uptick have driven long‑end yields higher, increasing financing costs; absent credit widening, the effect remains concentrated in duration-sensitive valuations.
stories.conclusion: Evidence supports a US long‑end tightening driven by real yields and a term‑premium rise, but the structural market‑absorption channel (dealer/auction evidence) is unresolved.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Canonical MOVE/Treasury volatility evidence or dealer/auction absorption showing failed bids would weaken the conclusion that transmission is contained.

stories.title: AI/semiconductor leadership is propping headline indices while breadth is concentrated
stories.whatChanged: AI/semiconductor baskets show very strong breadth even as broad measures remain mixed.
stories.whyItMatters: Concentrated leadership can mask underlying breadth weakness, so headline indices may be fragile if leadership falters or credit/volatility widen.
stories.mechanism: Earnings/positioning in AI/semis are supporting index levels and delaying broad market weakness that might otherwise follow rising yields.
stories.conclusion: Concentrated AI/semiconductor strength is materially supporting headline indices and therefore masking incomplete transmission of rates stress so far.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Sustained deterioration in large‑cap breadth or HY/IG widening accompanying an AI sell‑off would invalidate the masking explanation.

stories.title: Distillate/heating‑oil cracks are elevated and can support breakevens despite softening crude
stories.whatChanged: Distillate crack proxy and heating oil spot remain elevated while WTI is softer, suggesting product‑led inflation pressure.
stories.whyItMatters: Product stress can sustain breakevens and long yields even if crude weakens, prolonging rates pressure.
stories.mechanism: Regional refined‑product tightness (distillate/heating oil) is supporting inflation compensation independent of front‑month crude moves.
stories.conclusion: Product cracks are consistent with product‑led support for breakevens; regional inventory and refinery utilisation confirmation is still required.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Regional PADD inventory draws and refinery utilisation evidence showing persistent tightness would strengthen the story; inventories rebuilding would weaken it.

verified.title: Duration stress is global

verified.title: NBIS analyst catalyst verified
verified.detail: BNP Paribas upgraded Nebius Group from Neutral to Outperform and raised its price target from $260 to $399 on 24 September 2026, independently confirming a catalyst cited in the StockedUp transcript.

verified.title: US–China tariff cliff pushed out
verified.detail: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. and China agreed to extend their trade truce through 10 January 2027, reducing the immediate tariff-cliff risk while broader negotiations continue.

verified.title: US–Iran diplomacy is active
verified.detail: President Trump said U.S.-Iran talks were continuing during the UN General Assembly and that he believed a settlement would be reached; this verifies active diplomacy but not the transcript's specific Hormuz-for-sanctions terms.

verified.title: Diesel export-policy risk
verified.detail: The U.S. Chamber warned that restricting U.S. diesel or fuel exports could squeeze refiners and risk reducing supplies of diesel, gasoline and jet fuel, potentially worsening consumer costs.

verified.title: Late-September midterm seasonality
verified.detail: Citadel Securities' historical midterm-year path shows equities tending to weaken into around September 30 before a stronger average year-end phase; this supports late-September seasonality as context, not a forecast.

verified.title: META Muse catalyst verified
verified.detail: Meta launched its Muse personal AI agent and said it planned integration with smart glasses, independently confirming the product catalyst behind the creator's META discussion.

verified.title: RKLB defence-space catalyst verified
verified.detail: Rocket Lab said it was selected for the U.S. Space Force NITE-STAR IDIQ program, which has a ceiling of up to $981 million across participating vendors, confirming the defence-space catalyst cited by StockedUp.
